keyPoints.en: Small organisms rely on diffusion; large multicellular animals need a transport (circulatory) system.
keyPoints.bm: Organisma kecil bergantung pada resapan; haiwan multisel besar memerlukan sistem pengangkutan (peredaran).

keyPoints.en: Components: a pump (heart), a medium (blood/haemolymph), vessels and valves.
keyPoints.bm: Komponen: pam (jantung), medium (darah/hemolimfa), salur dan injap.

keyPoints.en: Open system (insects): haemolymph bathes organs in the haemocoel.
keyPoints.bm: Sistem terbuka (serangga): hemolimfa memandikan organ dalam hemoseol.

keyPoints.en: Closed system: single circulation in fish (2-chambered heart); double in amphibians (3), birds and mammals (4).
keyPoints.bm: Sistem tertutup: peredaran tunggal dalam ikan (jantung 2 ruang); ganda dua dalam amfibia (3), burung dan mamalia (4).

question.en: Why is double circulation more efficient?
question.bm: Mengapa peredaran ganda dua lebih cekap?

answer.en: Blood returns to the heart after the lungs and is pumped again at high pressure to the body.
answer.bm: Darah kembali ke jantung selepas peparu dan dipam semula pada tekanan tinggi ke badan.

tip.en: Count how many times blood passes through the heart in one full circuit: once (single) or twice (double).
tip.bm: Kira berapa kali darah melalui jantung dalam satu kitaran lengkap: sekali (tunggal) atau dua kali (ganda dua).

keyPoints.en: Blood: plasma (water, nutrients, hormones, CO₂, proteins) + red cells (O₂) + white cells (defence) + platelets (clotting).
keyPoints.bm: Darah: plasma (air, nutrien, hormon, CO₂, protein) + sel merah (O₂) + sel putih (pertahanan) + platlet (pembekuan).

keyPoints.en: Heart: 4 chambers; left side pumps oxygenated blood, right side deoxygenated; septum separates them.
keyPoints.bm: Jantung: 4 ruang; sebelah kiri mengepam darah beroksigen, sebelah kanan terdeoksigen; septum memisahkannya.

keyPoints.en: Pathway: vena cava → RA → RV → pulmonary artery → lungs → pulmonary vein → LA → LV → aorta → body.
keyPoints.bm: Laluan: vena kava → AK → VK → arteri pulmonari → peparu → vena pulmonari → AKi → VKi → aorta → badan.

keyPoints.en: Arteries: thick elastic walls, high pressure. Veins: thinner walls, valves, low pressure. Capillaries: one cell thick for exchange.
keyPoints.bm: Arteri: dinding tebal kenyal, tekanan tinggi. Vena: dinding nipis, injap, tekanan rendah. Kapilari: setebal satu sel untuk pertukaran.

keyPoints.en: Skeletal muscles squeeze veins to help blood return to the heart.
keyPoints.bm: Otot rangka memicit vena untuk membantu darah kembali ke jantung.

question.en: Why do veins need valves but arteries mostly don't?
question.bm: Mengapa vena memerlukan injap tetapi arteri kebanyakannya tidak?

answer.en: Blood pressure in veins is low, so valves stop blood flowing backwards.
answer.bm: Tekanan darah dalam vena rendah, jadi injap menghalang darah mengalir balik.

keyPoints.en: Heart muscle is myogenic: the beat starts in the heart itself, at the SA node (pacemaker).
keyPoints.bm: Otot jantung miogenik: degupan bermula dalam jantung sendiri, di nodus SA (perentak).

keyPoints.en: Signal path: SA node → atria contract → AV node (delay) → bundle of His → Purkinje fibres → ventricles contract.
keyPoints.bm: Laluan isyarat: nodus SA → atrium mengecut → nodus AV (lengah) → berkas His → gentian Purkinje → ventrikel mengecut.

keyPoints.en: Systole = contraction; diastole = relaxation. 'Lub' = AV valves close; 'dub' = semilunar valves close.
keyPoints.bm: Sistol = pengecutan; diastol = pengenduran. 'Lub' = injap AV tutup; 'dub' = injap sabit tutup.

keyPoints.en: The medulla oblongata adjusts heart rate through nerves; adrenaline speeds it up.
keyPoints.bm: Medula oblongata melaraskan kadar degupan melalui saraf; adrenalina mempercepatkannya.

keyPoints.en: Blood pressure is written systolic/diastolic, e.g. 120/80 mmHg.
keyPoints.bm: Tekanan darah ditulis sistolik/diastolik, cth. 120/80 mmHg.

question.en: Why does heart rate increase during exercise?
question.bm: Mengapa kadar degupan jantung meningkat semasa bersenam?

answer.en: Muscles need more O₂ and glucose and must remove more CO₂, so the medulla sends signals to speed up the SA node.
answer.bm: Otot memerlukan lebih O₂ dan glukosa serta perlu menyingkir lebih CO₂, jadi medula menghantar isyarat untuk mempercepat nodus SA.

tip.en: An artificial pacemaker replaces a faulty SA node.
tip.bm: Perentak tiruan menggantikan nodus SA yang rosak.

keyPoints.en: Clotting stops blood loss and keeps germs out of wounds.
keyPoints.bm: Pembekuan menghentikan kehilangan darah dan menghalang kuman memasuki luka.

keyPoints.en: Damaged tissue and platelets release thromboplastin.
keyPoints.bm: Tisu rosak dan platlet membebaskan tromboplastin.

keyPoints.en: Thromboplastin + Ca²⁺ + vitamin K convert prothrombin → thrombin.
keyPoints.bm: Tromboplastin + Ca²⁺ + vitamin K menukarkan protrombin → trombin.

keyPoints.en: Thrombin converts soluble fibrinogen → insoluble fibrin threads that trap blood cells → clot.
keyPoints.bm: Trombin menukarkan fibrinogen terlarut → bebenang fibrin tidak larut yang memerangkap sel darah → beku.

keyPoints.en: Haemophilia: inherited lack of a clotting factor; thrombosis: an unwanted clot inside a vessel.
keyPoints.bm: Hemofilia: kekurangan faktor pembekuan yang diwarisi; trombosis: beku yang tidak diingini dalam salur.

question.en: Why do doctors check vitamin K levels before some surgeries?
question.bm: Mengapa doktor memeriksa aras vitamin K sebelum sesetengah pembedahan?

answer.en: Vitamin K is needed to make prothrombin; without it, blood won't clot properly.
answer.bm: Vitamin K diperlukan untuk menghasilkan protrombin; tanpanya, darah tidak membeku dengan baik.

tip.en: Learn the cascade as 'T-P-T-F-F': Thromboplastin, Prothrombin, Thrombin, Fibrinogen, Fibrin.
tip.bm: Ingat rangkaian 'T-P-T-F-F': Tromboplastin, Protrombin, Trombin, Fibrinogen, Fibrin.

keyPoints.en: ABO blood groups depend on antigens (A, B) on red blood cells and antibodies (anti-A, anti-B) in plasma.
keyPoints.bm: Kumpulan darah ABO bergantung pada antigen (A, B) pada sel darah merah dan antibodi (anti-A, anti-B) dalam plasma.

keyPoints.en: A: antigen A, anti-B. B: antigen B, anti-A. AB: both antigens, no antibodies. O: no antigens, both antibodies.
keyPoints.bm: A: antigen A, anti-B. B: antigen B, anti-A. AB: kedua-dua antigen, tiada antibodi. O: tiada antigen, kedua-dua antibodi.

keyPoints.en: Mismatched transfusion → agglutination (clumping) → blocked vessels, can be fatal.
keyPoints.bm: Pemindahan tidak sepadan → aglutinasi (penggumpalan) → salur tersumbat, boleh membawa maut.

keyPoints.en: O = universal donor; AB = universal recipient. Rhesus factor (Rh+/Rh−) must also match.
keyPoints.bm: O = penderma universal; AB = penerima universal. Faktor Rhesus (Rh+/Rh−) juga mesti sepadan.

question.en: Can a group B person donate to a group A person?
question.bm: Bolehkah orang kumpulan B menderma kepada orang kumpulan A?

answer.en: No — the recipient's anti-B antibodies will agglutinate the donor's B red cells.
answer.bm: Tidak — antibodi anti-B penerima akan mengaglutinasi sel merah B penderma.

tip.en: Check the DONOR's antigens against the RECIPIENT's antibodies.
tip.bm: Semak antigen PENDERMA berbanding antibodi PENERIMA.

keyPoints.en: Atherosclerosis: cholesterol plaque narrows arteries.
keyPoints.bm: Aterosklerosis: plak kolesterol menyempitkan arteri.

keyPoints.en: Hypertension (high blood pressure) strains the heart and vessels.
keyPoints.bm: Hipertensi (tekanan darah tinggi) membebankan jantung dan salur.

keyPoints.en: Blocked coronary artery → heart attack; blocked/burst brain artery → stroke.
keyPoints.bm: Arteri koronari tersumbat → serangan jantung; arteri otak tersumbat/pecah → strok.

keyPoints.en: Risk factors: smoking, high-fat/salt diet, obesity, no exercise, stress, diabetes, family history.
keyPoints.bm: Faktor risiko: merokok, diet tinggi lemak/garam, obesiti, kurang bersenam, tekanan, diabetes, sejarah keluarga.

keyPoints.en: Treatments: medication, angioplasty (stent), bypass surgery; prevention through healthy lifestyle.
keyPoints.bm: Rawatan: ubat, angioplasti (sten), pembedahan pintasan; pencegahan melalui gaya hidup sihat.

question.en: Why does smoking increase the risk of heart attack?
question.bm: Mengapa merokok meningkatkan risiko serangan jantung?

answer.en: Nicotine raises blood pressure and damages artery walls, helping plaque build up; CO reduces O₂ to the heart muscle.
answer.bm: Nikotina menaikkan tekanan darah dan merosakkan dinding arteri, membantu plak terkumpul; CO mengurangkan O₂ ke otot jantung.

tip.en: Name the vessel affected and what happens to the tissue it supplies.
tip.bm: Namakan salur yang terjejas dan apa berlaku kepada tisu yang dibekalkannya.

keyPoints.en: Tissue fluid leaks from capillaries; most returns to the blood, the rest drains into lymph vessels as lymph.
keyPoints.bm: Bendalir tisu meresap dari kapilari; kebanyakannya kembali ke darah, selebihnya mengalir ke salur limfa sebagai limfa.

keyPoints.en: Lymph flows one way (with valves) through lymph nodes and returns to blood via the subclavian veins.
keyPoints.bm: Limfa mengalir sehala (dengan injap) melalui nodus limfa dan kembali ke darah melalui vena subklavikel.

keyPoints.en: Lymph nodes contain lymphocytes that filter and destroy germs; the spleen and thymus are lymphatic organs.
keyPoints.bm: Nodus limfa mengandungi limfosit yang menapis dan memusnahkan kuman; limpa dan timus ialah organ limfa.

keyPoints.en: Lacteals in villi absorb fatty acids and glycerol into the lymphatic system.
keyPoints.bm: Lakteal dalam vilus menyerap asid lemak dan gliserol ke dalam sistem limfa.

question.en: Why do lymph nodes in the neck swell during a sore throat?
question.bm: Mengapa nodus limfa di leher membengkak semasa sakit tekak?

answer.en: Lymphocytes multiply there to fight the infection.
answer.bm: Limfosit membiak di situ untuk melawan jangkitan.

tip.en: Lymph has no pump — it moves by skeletal muscle squeezing, like veins.
tip.bm: Limfa tiada pam — ia bergerak melalui picitan otot rangka, seperti vena.

keyPoints.en: Oedema: tissue fluid builds up and causes swelling when it isn't drained.
keyPoints.bm: Edema: bendalir tisu terkumpul dan menyebabkan bengkak apabila tidak disalirkan.

keyPoints.en: Elephantiasis (filariasis): parasitic worms spread by mosquitoes block lymph vessels → huge swelling of limbs.
keyPoints.bm: Untut (filariasis): cacing parasit yang disebarkan nyamuk menyumbat salur limfa → bengkak besar pada anggota.

keyPoints.en: Lymphoma: cancer of the lymphatic system (lymphocytes).
keyPoints.bm: Limfoma: kanser sistem limfa (limfosit).

keyPoints.en: Prevention: mosquito control, early treatment, healthy lifestyle.
keyPoints.bm: Pencegahan: kawalan nyamuk, rawatan awal, gaya hidup sihat.

question.en: How can filariasis be prevented in a village?
question.bm: Bagaimana filariasis boleh dicegah di sebuah kampung?

answer.en: Destroy mosquito breeding sites, use nets and repellent, and mass drug treatment.
answer.bm: Musnahkan tempat pembiakan nyamuk, guna kelambu dan penghalau, serta rawatan ubat secara besar-besaran.

tip.en: Link lymph problems back to the job of the lymphatic system — draining fluid and fighting germs.
tip.bm: Kaitkan masalah limfa dengan tugas sistem limfa — menyalirkan bendalir dan melawan kuman.
